title: Factor geometric purity into inverse orientation and tensor counit transpose
statement: Fix a purity finite setting P and a smooth separated finite-type map f:X->Y of pure relative dimension d between finite-type k-schemes. Put N(M)=E_Y^-1 E_Y(M), with the specified realization unit u_M:M~N(M) [def-pur-finite-geometric-purity-coordinates]. In the fixed coefficient derived category let omega=G(A_Y), and define T(M)=f*N(M) tensor omega. Define a_M:H_d(M)->T(M) as H_d(u_M), then twist reassociation, then 1 tensor Pi_f^-1. For every etale presentation c:C(M0)~N(M), define t_(M,c):T(M)->G(M) as the existing smoothPurityTheta at that presentation followed by G(u_M^-1). For bounded constructible finite-Tor M, the specified Gamma_M equals a_M followed by t_(M,c). For a commuting self-square with maps gX,gY, define S_M:Q(T(M))~f*N(RM) tensor Q(omega) using canonical tensor pullback, Qf*(u_M^-1), the inverse-image square and f*(u_RM). Define e_omega:Q(omega)->omega using ordinary exceptional base change at A_Y, its canonical ordinary unit pullback, and the existing etale/pro-etale dualizing comparison. Neither S nor e_omega is defined using Pi or Gamma.

source.place: Factor geometric purity into inverse orientation and tensor counit transpose

proof.text: The given presentation is one of those quantified in existsUnique_smoothPurityTensorMap. Its choose_spec equation identifies the chosen tensor map with (1 tensor Pi inverse) followed by theta.

source.place: Definition of the tensor purity map

proof.text: Substitute that equation in geometricPurityMap. The first three factors are exactly a_M, and the remaining theta and exceptional inverse unit are t_(M,c). Associativity yields Gamma=a;t. S is the tensor-pullback isomorphism followed by the square and the realization units. The dualizing exchange is ordinary exceptional base change at the unit transported by the canonical comparison.

theorem geometricPurityMap_factors
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (hM : finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos Y
      ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y P.Ring).functor.obj M))
    (M₀ : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule P.Coefficient Y)
    (e : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj M₀ ≅
        P.geometricPurityRealized Y M) :
    P.geometricPurityMap f d M hM =
      P.geometricPurityOrientationFactor f (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k)) d M ≫
        P.geometricPurityTensorFactor f (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k)) M M₀ e
